summary: Completed Round 9 testing: Visitor name search, camera toggle stability, and visitor list filtering. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: 25/26 tests passed (1 critical issue with rapid camera toggle causing unhandled rejection error overlay).

critical_bugs.issue: Rapid camera toggle (on/off 5 times quickly) causes unhandled rejection error overlay: 'The play() request was interrupted because the media was removed from the document'
critical_bugs.details: The error guard in camera.js lines 14-19 exists but doesn't prevent the Emergent error overlay from showing. The html5-qrcode library calls video.play() without handling the promise, and rapid toggling interrupts the play request. This violates the requirement that rapid camera toggle must NOT produce error overlay/unhandled rejection.
critical_bugs.workaround: Single camera toggle works fine. Only rapid toggling (< 100ms between clicks) triggers the error.

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix camera toggle rapid on/off error. The error guard in /app/frontend/src/lib/camera.js (lines 14-19) exists but doesn't prevent Emergent error overlay from showing when camera is toggled rapidly (< 100ms between clicks). The html5-qrcode library's video.play() promise rejection needs better handling. Requirement states: 'turning on/off rapidly multiple times must NOT produce any error overlay / unhandled rejection / red screen.' Current behavior: Shows 'Unhandled rejection' error overlay with message 'The play() request was interrupted because the media was removed from the document.' Single toggle works fine.
